pages.title: Assembly Matrix
pages.text: Combine a standard Chest, Crafting Table, and a block of Trinitite to assemble the portable $(5)Transmutation Cube$(0).

pages.title: Operation & Interface
pages.text: Right-click to open its 5-slot catalytic matrix. Insert specific alchemical ingredients and press $(5)Transmute$(0).$(br2)The Cube rearranges atomic bonds instantaneously, emitting an alchemical hum when a recipe succeeds.
